views.query:
SELECT
    [ID],
    [Title],
    [Work Item Type],
    [Assigned To],
    [Type],
    [State],
    [Attached File Count],
    [Author Function],
    [Area Path],
    [Iteration Path],
    [Target Date],
    [Author Approval Date]
FROM WorkItems
WHERE
    (
        [Work Item Type] = 'Document'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'DHFIndex'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'Artifact'
    )
    AND
    (
        [Type] = 'DHFI'
        OR [Type] = 'Design History File Index'
    )
    AND [State] = 'Approved'
    AND
    (
        [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\asp data etl view'
        OR [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\aspdataetlview'
    )

ORDER BY [ID] DSC

SELECT
    [ID],
    [Title],
    [Work Item Type],
    [Assigned To],
    [Type],
    [State],
    [Attached File Count],
    [Author Function],
    [Area Path],
    [Iteration Path],
    [Target Date],
    [Author Approval Date]
FROM WorkItems
WHERE
    (
        [Work Item Type] = 'Document'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'DHFIndex'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'Artifact'
    )
    AND
    (
        [Type] = 'DHFI'
        OR [Type] = 'Design History File Index'
    )
    AND [State] = 'Approved'
    AND
    (
        [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\clinical platforms'
        OR [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\ClinicalPlatform'
        OR [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\DevX\ClinicalPlatform'
        OR [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\xDev\ClinicalPlatform'
    )
ORDER BY [ID] DSC

SELECT
    [ID],
    [Title],
    [Work Item Type],
    [Assigned To],
    [Type],
    [State],
    [Attached File Count],
    [Author Function],
    [Area Path],
    [Iteration Path],
    [Target Date],
    [Author Approval Date]
FROM WorkItems
WHERE
    (
        [Work Item Type] = 'Document'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'Artifact'
    )
    AND [State] = 'Approved'
    AND [Area Path] UNDER 'DHP.Vault\xDev\IOCC'
    AND
    (
        [Type] = 'Verification Specification and Report'
        OR [Type] = 'Release Notes'
    )

SELECT
    [ID],
    [Title],
    [Work Item Type],
    [Assigned To],
    [Type],
    [State],
    [Attached File Count],
    [Author Function],
    [Area Path],
    [Iteration Path],
    [Target Date],
    [Author Approval Date]
FROM WorkItems
WHERE
    (
        [Work Item Type] = 'Document'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'DHFIndex'
        OR [Work Item Type] = 'Artifact'
    )
    AND
    (
        [Type] = 'DHFI'
        OR [Type] = 'Design History File Index'
    )
    AND [State] = 'Approved'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\clinical platforms'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\ClinicalPlatform'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\DevX\ClinicalPlatform'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\xDev\IOCC'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\xDev\ClinicalPlatform'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\asp data etl view'
    AND [Area Path] NOT UNDER 'DHP.Vault\Dev\aspdataetlview'

ORDER BY [ID] DSC

SELECT
    [System.Id],
    [System.WorkItemType],
    [SourceProgram],
    [PsName],
    [Release],
    [System.Title],
    [System.State],
    [VerificationDeviation],
    [System.AssignedTo],
    [ReleaseIntent],
    [Year],
    [PI],
    [DRPEDate],
    [DRPCDate],
    [DRfHDate],
    [DDTDate],
    [DRPEStatus],
    [DRPCStatus],
    [DRfHStatus],
    [DDTStatus],
    [IsDesignReview]
FROM WorkItems
WHERE
    [System.WorkItemType] = 'Release'
    AND [System.State] <> 'Removed'
    AND [System.AreaPath] <> 'DHP.Release\Recycle Bin'
ORDER BY [System.Id] DESC
